description: Provision a Google Cloud Bigtable BigtableGCPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the bigtable.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 BigtableGCPolicy spec.

columnFamily.description: Immutable. The name of the column family.

deletionPolicy.description: The deletion policy for the GC policy. Setting ABANDON allows the resource to be abandoned rather than deleted. This is useful for GC policy as it cannot be deleted in a replicated instance. Possible values are: "ABANDON".

gcRules.description: Serialized JSON string for garbage collection policy. Conflicts with "mode", "max_age" and "max_version".

instanceRef.description: The name of the Bigtable instance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed BigtableInstance resource.

name.description: The name of a BigtableInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BigtableInstance resource.

maxAge.description: Immutable. NOTE: 'gc_rules' is more flexible, and should be preferred over this field for new resources. This field may be deprecated in the future. GC policy that applies to all cells older than the given age.

days.description: DEPRECATED. Deprecated in favor of duration. Immutable. Number of days before applying GC policy.

duration.description: Immutable. Duration before applying GC policy.

maxVersion.description: Immutable. NOTE: 'gc_rules' is more flexible, and should be preferred over this field for new resources. This field may be deprecated in the future. GC policy that applies to all versions of a cell except for the most recent.

number.description: Immutable. Number of version before applying the GC policy.

mode.description: Immutable. NOTE: 'gc_rules' is more flexible, and should be preferred over this field for new resources. This field may be deprecated in the future. If multiple policies are set, you should choose between UNION OR INTERSECTION.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

tableRef.description: The name of the table. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed BigtableTable resource.

name.description: The name of a BigtableInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BigtableInstance resource.

title: GCP Bigtable BigtableGCPolicy
